title: BUG temp basal increases and SMB in Low Glucoe Suspend
symptom: In Low Glucose Suspend (LGS) mode, SMBs were given and temp basal increases occurred, despite LGS being enabled. The user expected LGS to prevent such insulin delivery.
cause: IOB was negative during the night, so LGS worked as designed and did not provide more insulin than defined in profile. SMBs and High TBRs kept IOB negative.
fix: No fix needed; behavior was as designed. The user was advised to read documentation on LGS mode.
evidence_quote: IOB was negative during all the night so LGS worked as designed and didn't provide more insulin that what was defined in profile. SMBs and High TBRs kept IOB negative.
